items.question: What kind of photos work best for wedding dance videos?
items.answer: Clear, front-facing couple photos work best. Engagement photos, wedding portraits, and even casual couple selfies all produce great results. Make sure both faces are clearly visible.

items.question: Can I use this for a save-the-date video?
items.answer: Absolutely! Many couples create AI dance videos from their engagement photos for save-the-date announcements. It's a unique, memorable way to share the news.

items.question: What dance styles are available for weddings?
items.answer: We offer romantic sway, elegant waltz-inspired moves, fun party dances, and even trending TikTok dances. The Gentle Sway and Romantic Sway templates are most popular for weddings.

items.question: Can I make my parents' old wedding photo dance?
items.answer: Yes! AI works with any photo, including vintage and old photographs. Creating a dance video from your parents' or grandparents' wedding photo makes a wonderful anniversary gift.

items.question: How long are the generated videos?
items.answer: Wedding dance videos are typically 5-15 seconds, perfect for social media sharing and reception slideshows. The length depends on the dance template you choose.

items.question: Is the video quality good enough for a wedding slideshow?
items.answer: Yes, all videos are generated in HD quality suitable for projection at receptions, sharing on social media, or embedding in wedding websites.
